properties.name: A change's redo list reaches a drawing or model that DOCUMENTS a reached part
properties.rationale: Root cause (fact:the-redo-list-reaches-a-drawing-or-model-only-by-realizes-so-documents-edges-leave-it-empty-2026-10-26): the note named DOCUMENTS ("what a record documents") while the walk followed it only outward from an Artifact, so the edge a designer draws from a sheet to the part it shows filled nothing; nothing checked the note against the walk. Fixed at the walk, and the note now states each group's edges so the two can be compared. The restriction on a drawing's outward DOCUMENTS is the other half of the same reading: DOCUMENTS from a drawing names its subject, not something resting on it. Before/after, measured: on main 02e2739c8 the new test fails (no redo list at all); with the fix it passes with the file's seven other redo-list tests. Not done here: computations stay empty on the trial design for a separate reason (flo2-calc records name no inputs), which is flo2-calc's. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: owed.rs redo_list: from a reached part, the walk now follows incoming DOCUMENTS as well as REALIZES from an Artifact whose kind is drawing or model, listing it under drawings/models "because it documents" the part. A drawing's or model's OWN outward DOCUMENTS is no longer walked (only a kept computation's is), so a sheet showing several parts does not put the other parts on the list as parts to redo. REDO_NOTE now says, group by group, which edge and direction fills it. Test: a_changed_quantity_names_every_kept_computation_that_used_it.rs::a_part_documented_by_a_drawing_and_a_model_returns_both.
